Impeccino doctor: <WS>

needs a command (2):
  product-schema-legacy  [PRODUCT.md]
    PRODUCT.md has no schema stamp and none of the sections the current record adds (Positioning, Operating Context, Evidence on Hand, Product Principles), so it predates this version of the product record.
    → Offer `init`, which preserves confirmed answers and fills the gaps by interview. Do not rewrite the file from inference.
  design-sidecar-schema-outdated  [DESIGN.json]
    DESIGN.json is schemaVersion 1; the current sidecar is 2. Token primitives moved to the DESIGN.md frontmatter, so the old shape carries values that are now read from two places.
    → Offer `document` to regenerate the sidecar. It reads the existing DESIGN.md, so no interview is needed.

worth saying (6):
  legacy-state-dir  [.impeccino/]
    A `.impeccino/` directory from an earlier Impeccino layout sits at the project root. Nothing reads it any more: project state now lives in top-level files and Impeccino keeps no config file.
    → Tell the user where its contents belong, then offer to delete the directory once they have moved what they want to keep: `design.json` becomes `DESIGN.json` next to DESIGN.md; each `surfaces/*.md` brief becomes a section of `SURFACES.md` (write it with `impeccino surface-brief write`); detector ignores in `config.json` and `config.local.json` become `<!-- impeccino-disable <rule> -->` waivers or declared tokens in DESIGN.md, or `.gitignore` / `.gitattributes` entries for whole files; decisions in `critique/ignore.md` become brand commitments in PRODUCT.md or rules in DESIGN.md. Everything else (critique snapshots, hook caches, review screenshots) can be deleted.
  product-deprecated-register  [PRODUCT.md]
    PRODUCT.md still carries a `## Register` section. v4 replaced the brand/product register axis with the four visitor modes (Persuade, Operate, Read, Experience), which are chosen per surface and persisted in that surface's brief. Nothing reads `## Register` any more.
    → Treat `## Register` as absent for every decision this session. Offer to delete the section; do not let its value influence the work either way.
  design-sidecar-stale  [DESIGN.json]
    DESIGN.md was edited after DESIGN.json was generated, so the sidecar's ramps, shadows, motion tokens, and component snippets may contradict it.
    → Offer `document` to refresh the sidecar, preserving DESIGN.md.
  design-md-coverage  [DESIGN.md]
    DESIGN.md has no components section. Agents generating new screens must infer those rules from the implementation.
    → Ask whether the section never applied or was never written. `document` fills it from the code if the project has the answer in its CSS.
  design-waiver-unknown-rule  [DESIGN.md]
    DESIGN.md waives rule id(s) the detector does not have: `not-a-real-rule`. Either the rule was renamed or removed, or the id was mistyped and has never waived anything.
    → Report the exact ids. Fix a typo in place; drop a waiver whose rule is gone, keeping the design rule it sat next to.
  surface-brief-orphaned  [SURFACES.md]
    1 surface brief(s) in SURFACES.md name a primary target that no longer exists: `src/old.astro`.
    → Ask whether the surface moved (write its brief again under the new target and delete the old section) or was removed (delete its section from SURFACES.md). Until then the brief is authority for a file that is gone.

Applied nothing.
